subject: [PATCH v4 17/19] selftests/mm: race collapse of windows with holes

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel's selftest suite to verify that khugepaged correctly handles collapsing windows with holes. The test runs at both ends of the occupancy scale, from fully populated windows to windows full of holes, and checks for correctness by verifying that every racing page reads as its pattern or zero. The test is designed to catch any potential issues related to the collapse of windows with holes under concurrent access.
